problem_restatement: Advance the same-run V58 evidence prefix after the prior flat checkpoint, distinguish executable signal episodes from fills, verify duplicate-position containment, and preserve exit-policy evidence without selecting from unresolved open outcomes.
success_criteria: Same run and profile identity are preserved.
New independent executable-BBO episode onsets are deduplicated and fully covered.
Any second same-symbol episode while occupied produces no additional live entry acknowledgement or fill.
Open positions remain reconciled and protected by venue reduce-only stops.
No live strategy, risk, sizing, leverage, route, or exit configuration changes from provisional evidence.

resolved_execution_delta.interpretation: The two new fills are the ETH and SP500 opening fills. Neither lifecycle was resolved at the frozen prefix.

eth_breakout_precompression_pullback_bid.interpretation: One volatile path is mixed across horizons and remains an unresolved live lifecycle; it cannot establish an entry or exit edge.

hip3_breakout_pressure_sp500_spcx_fresh1.interpretation: The two short-horizon paths failed to clear modeled cost through thirty minutes. Only the first path had matured to sixty minutes and was slightly positive. This sample is insufficient for strategy or risk inference.

same_symbol_occupancy_validation.interpretation: The independent observer recorded a second eligible episode while SP500 was already occupied, but it had no execution authority and the live asset ledger contains no duplicate entry.

recommendation: Make no live change from this prefix. Allow the ETH and SP500 lifecycles to resolve under their pre-existing V58 exits, then reconcile exact fills, fees, funding, MFE, MAE, peak giveback, exit reason, stop cleanup, and the predeclared exit-policy challengers.

alternatives_considered.tradeoff: Could react faster to an apparent weakness, but would select policy from one unresolved ETH path and at most two SP500 paths.
The observer is explicitly report-only and same-symbol occupancy correctly prevented duplicate exposure.
Slower conclusion, but protects causal attribution and avoids outcome-conditioned exit changes.

uncertainties_risks_and_failure_modes: Open-lifecycle marks can reverse before exit and are not realized economics.
Two SP500 paths and one ETH path cannot distinguish normal variance from structural decay.
Executable-BBO markouts are not hypothetical fills and do not include every queue or latency effect.
A venue stop, backend process, or evidence observer can fail after this frozen prefix; current protection must continue to be monitored.
The current configuration may still have an exit-quality weakness, but selecting from the open outcome would contaminate that inference.
falsifiers_and_update_conditions: A second live SP500 entry acknowledgement or open fill during the same occupied lifecycle would falsify the occupancy-containment pass.
A missing, non-reduce-only, wrong-sized, or wrong-side venue stop would invalidate the protection assessment and require immediate technical escalation.
A resolved lifecycle or new technical gap changes the evidence state and requires a new immutable audit prefix and delta.
A materially larger prospective sample with negative after-cost independent paths across predeclared horizons would increase confidence in entry decay; robust positive paths would decrease it.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Resolve and reconcile the open ETH and SP500 lifecycles under unchanged V58 policy, then update the exit-policy evidence without selecting from the observed open path.
